text:
Ivy (Partnerships): quick sync re: SatCom integrator. they're onboarding and asked about how our 'approximate ingestion' impacts entitlement activation timing. need a short answer for their tech doc.
Diego (Eng-ML): we infer entitlements at write-time with best-effort counts. approximate ingestion may delay activation inference by up to one window (default 1 hour) because we stitch asynchronously.
Hanna (Billing): activation timing matters for their trial-to-paid conversion. can we expose an 'activation_confirmed' webhook when entitlement crosses threshold?
Zoe (Partner Eng): yes we can. plan: emit activation_confirmed with payload {customer_id, entitlement_id, observed_units, window_start, window_end, confidence_score}. confidence_score indicates if the number is estimated.
Marcus (Revenue Ops): what confidence thresholds map to billable vs informational?
Diego (Eng-ML): suggest: confidence >=0.97 => billable as-is; 0.85-0.97 => billable but flagged for potential reconciliation; <0.85 => informational only, partner must opt-in to bill immediately.
Ivy (Partnerships): good. also add note: partners can request 'deterministic activation' where we wait for raw replay before confirming but that adds up to 48h delay.
Hanna (Billing): add to docs: partner must accept billing_delay=T (0 or 48h) at onboarding. Default 0 with our confidence thresholds.
Zoe (Partner Eng): implement quick example webhook: POST /partners/satcom/entitlement/activation
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <key>
Body: {"customer_id":"acct_987","entitlement":"seat_premium","units":1500,"confidence":0.93}

ops-bot: "note: webhook payloads must include request_id and X-Redwood-Signature"
Marcus (Revenue Ops): action items: Zoe implement webhook sample + docs; Diego provide confidence thresholds and brief note on how confidence is calculated; Hanna update onboarding doc to include billing_delay opt-out. Deadline Tue EOD?
Diego (Eng-ML): will provide a one-paragraph explanation of confidence scoring by EOD.
Ivy (Partnerships): I'll update partner onboarding checklist and the SatCom tech doc after we have the webhook sample.
ops-bot: "task created: #DOC-802 (partner-activation-webhook), #SPEC-203 (confidence-scoring-note), #ONB-45 (billing-delay-flag)"
Hanna (Billing): last ask: include a field 'activation_source' to show if activation was inferred from sampled counts or raw counts.
Diego (Eng-ML): added: activation_source=(sampled|raw|replayed).
Ivy (Partnerships): perfect. I'll send this to SatCom and close the ticket.
ops-bot: "thread closed: satcom-entitlement-activation-docs-in-progress"
